note:
Per-surface fallback templates. content_role=template on every row. Natal placement renders in TWO PARTS: the planet-in-sign paragraph, then (when a house is known) the house-context paragraph below it. Slots resolve per contracts/CONTENT-ROLE-CONTRACT.json vocabulary families; optional {{#blocks}} are suppressed cleanly when a slot has no eligible row (never filled with generic phrases). Voice: only {{possessive}} varies by viewer ("Your" / "Sofia's"); all slot values are voice-neutral per the grammar-frame contract, so no pronoun conjugation ever happens inside stored data. STYLE RULES: no em dashes; templates are glue only, all slot content is verbatim approved-source wording.
